content_sections.heading: About SVSU
content_sections.text: Shri Vishwakarma Skill University (SVSU) is located at Village Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana. The notice is issued by its Registrar under Ref. No. SVSU/2026/Estt./3576 dated 03.11.2026. The University says the complete details, including eligibility conditions, selection criteria and general instructions, are available on its website www.svsu.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants are to fill the offline application form printed in the notice and send it by the closing date, 26.11.2026 (up to 05:00 P.M.). Each page of the form must be signed by the applicant. The signed copy, along with all supporting self-attested documents, goes to this address: The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan, Administrative Block, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Village-Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana- 121002 The notice names no postal mode and gives no text to write on the envelope. It does not give an email address for applications. Incomplete applications, or those received after the last date for any reason including postal delay, are rejected outright. The notice says the fee is accepted through offline mode only and prints http://forms.eduqfix.com/svsurectff/add in the same sentence. The payment slip must be attached to the application form. Fee once deposited is neither transferable nor refundable or adjustable. The fee relaxation applies to the reserved categories of Haryana State only. Separately, the notice says that if a post is withdrawn from being filled, the University will refund the application fee to the applicants.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Signed application form, with each page signed, and a self-attested coloured passport size photograph pasted on it. Fee payment slip. All supporting documents self-attested, page numbered, with the attached documents listed in the form (item 21). Caste certificate, with a scanned copy for claiming fee concession. Scheduled Caste applicants must submit the certificate strictly as per State Govt. notification no. 22/163/2024-5HR-III dated 13.11.2024, otherwise no DSC/OSC reservation benefit is given and the application is rejected. Disability certificate for persons with disability, as the form asks. Document for conversion of CGPA into equivalent marks, if a Grade Point System applies. Experience certificate showing the period of work and designation with pay scale/pay band/pay level, supported by PF statement/Form 16/Bank Statement/ITR or other valid proof of salary. Permanently employed candidates: an advance copy of the application sent directly to the University by the last date, and an application through proper channel or a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. The form also asks for the Aadhaar number (desirable, but not mandatory), the names and addresses of two referees, employment record, academic details and, for in-service candidates, a check list to be filled by the employer for the last 5 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes screening, a written test, a skill test and an interview of shortlisted candidates. The dates of the tests and the interview are not given. Candidates found eligible by the Screening Committee and shortlisted by the University will be called for interview. Those declared ineligible will not be informed. Mere possession of the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the written test or interview, and the University may restrict the shortlisted applicants to a reasonable number. The written and skill tests are two mandatory components. A General category candidate must secure minimum 40% marks, and DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/PwBD candidates minimum 38% marks, in the written test as well as in the skill test. The selection is made on merit of both tests. The structure and syllabus of the test will be uploaded on the University website in due course. The written test is held first and a candidate must secure minimum 40% marks to qualify. The skill test (stenography) is then held for those who qualify. Candidates who qualify both tests are considered for checking of eligibility and document verification, and the notice says selection is made on merit of the written test. Original documents supporting the claims must be produced for verification before or at the time of interview, if called. No TA/DA is paid for attending any written test, skill test, presentation or interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 regular non-teaching posts: Assistant 2, Steno-typist (Hindi & English) 2, Hostel Attendant (Male & Female) 2, Sanitary Officer 1, Plumber 1, Restorer 1 and Carpenter 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SVSU non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The application must be sent by 26 November 2026, up to 05:00 P.M. Applications received after the last date, including by postal delay, are rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for SVSU recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 42 years as on last date. Age relaxation follows the Haryana Government letter dated 25.03.2022, only for Haryana categories and only where the post is reserved for them.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the SVSU Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Assistant post needs a Bachelor's Degree with minimum 50% marks and five years' experience as Clerk or Clerk-Cum-Data Entry Operator, plus Hindi/Sanskrit up to Matric or higher level. Computer and Internet proficiency is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for male General category candidates including DESM of Haryana, and for all candidates of other states. It is Rs. 250/- for Female General candidates of Haryana and for DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/ESM/EWS candidates of Haryana. It is Nil for Haryana PwD candidates with at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the offline form, sign each page and attach the fee payment slip and self-attested documents. Send it to The Assistant Registrar (Estt.), Takshashila Bhawan, Administrative Block, Shri Vishwakarma Skill University, Village-Dudhola, Palwal, Haryana- 121002.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SVSU non-teaching posts?
faq.answer: The notice describes a written test of 50 marks and a skill test of 50 marks, with a minimum of 40% for General and 38% for DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/PwBD candidates. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a skill test for the Steno-typist post?
faq.answer: Yes. The Steno-typist written test of 50 marks comes first, with minimum 40% to qualify, followed by a skill test (stenography) of qualifying nature for those who pass the written test.

faq.question: Q9. Are the SVSU posts permanent?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for the posts on regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Which posts are reserved in SVSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only the Assistant post is reserved, with one of its two posts for Gen and one for DSC (Deprived Scheduled Caste of Haryana). The other six posts are marked Gen.
